Three market places are not Italy, and this record cannot be raised from PIAZZA to NATIONAL. WINE PRICE IS NOT GRAPE PRICE: what the grower receives for the grapes is another thing and this series does not measure it. 'Ettogrado' is NOT euro per hectolitre, it is euro per hectolitre per degree of alcohol — comparing it with the 61.75 EUR/HL of the Commission series without converting means comparing two different units.
